summary: Run the hybrid worker on your own servers and install PIM Manager in any Azure region.

new.title: Hybrid worker on your own server
new.text: The hybrid worker can now run on an on-premises Windows server enabled for Azure Arc, with outbound connections only. Not yet proven on a live Arc server.

new.title: Deploy the hybrid worker with one command
new.text: One command now deploys the hybrid worker in the right order, on an Azure VM or an Arc server, and pauses for the Active Directory steps.

new.title: Install in any Azure region
new.text: Setup checks before anything is created that every service PIM Manager needs is offered in your chosen region, and suggests the nearest one that has them.

new.title: PIM Activator shows the Invardia shield
new.text: The PIM Activator icons now show the official PIM Manager shield, from the next Activator package.

fixes.title: Install wizard asks fewer questions
fixes.text: The install wizard no longer asks for admin account prefixes, and setup screens now say PIM Manager.
